title: Per-observation evidence receipt
description: Everything shown on one evidence card, and everything needed to reproduce it. Every public number on the card must come from this receipt. If a value is on the card it must be in this receipt. Ratified 2026-08-16 by Bob (task A0): no structural changes needed; clarified that reason_codes come from a fixed rule table only, never from model attribution; added waterfall_geometry_version to evidence for traceability. Revised 2026-08-16 in A0b review: evidence and scores now carry required fields (an empty object used to validate against a contract whose title promises everything on the card), and abstention_reason is conditionally required when decision is abstain.

snapshot_id.description: ID of the immutable snapshot this receipt was generated from.

model_checksum.description: SHA-256 of the model weights used. Required for reproducibility.

evidence.description: Separate evidence axes. Never collapse these into one composite score. Each axis is independently auditable. artifact_usable and physics_available are required because the nullability of every other field here is defined in terms of them, so a receipt that omits them cannot be interpreted.

visible_signal.description: Image-model score for signal presence. Calibrated probability.

target_consistency.description: Consistency between image-model output and the physics corridor.

artifact_usable.description: True if the waterfall PNG was downloaded, parsed, and cropped successfully. False blocks image-axis evidence; physics axis can still run.

physics_available.description: True if TLE, station coordinates, and rx-freq were all present and SGP4 ran without error.

residual_hz.description: Measured centre-of-mass offset between the visible trace and the physics corridor, in Hz. Null when artifact_usable or physics_available is false.

corridor_intersects_trace.description: True if the physics corridor overlaps the detected trace region. This is the primary output for kill gate 3. Null when either artifact_usable or physics_available is false.

waterfall_geometry_version.description: schema_version of the waterfall_geometry record used. Allows tracing back any pixel-mapping issue.

scores.description: Model outputs for this observation. calibrated_probability is required and may be null, so a receipt must state explicitly that no score was produced rather than leaving the field absent.

calibrated_probability.description: Calibrated posterior probability that this observation deserves review.

uncertainty.description: Epistemic uncertainty estimate (e.g. conformal prediction width or bootstrap variance).

ood_score.description: Out-of-distribution score. High means the observation resembles neither training positives nor negatives. Triggers abstention above threshold.

review_value.description: Expected information value of human review at the current prior. Used for queue ranking.

decision.description: abstain is a first-class outcome, not a failure mode. It means the evidence is insufficient to decide.

abstention_reason.description: Required when decision is 'abstain'. Describes why the model declined to decide (e.g. OOD, missing artifact, unknown client family).

reason_codes.description: Human-readable reason codes from a FIXED rule table. Never from model feature attribution or gradient methods, which are not causal explanations. Examples: CORRIDOR_MISS, LABEL_CONFLICT, OOD_STATION, MISSING_ARTIFACT.

api_label.description: Raw waterfall_status from the SatNOGS API. 'unknown' is stored as-is and never resolved.

artifact_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the waterfall PNG used to generate this receipt. Must match the snapshot manifest.

split.description: Split assignment: 'train', 'calibration', or 'test'. Null before splits are frozen.

station_id.description: Ground station id. Matches ground_station in source_observation.

allOf.$comment: abstain is a first-class outcome, so it has to carry its reason. Without this an abstaining receipt could ship with no explanation and still validate.
